profile.name: Riggverk Cursor Setup
profile.description: Cursor setup assets for global agents, canonical bundled skills, and Playwright MCP. Auto Review and permissions remain IDE-managed.

notes: Primary workflow: apply Cursor setup from the app to Cursor agents, canonical bundled skills, and Playwright MCP.
Select Auto Review manually in Cursor Settings > Agents > Run Mode; Riggverk does not inspect or write undocumented Cursor runtime state.
User Rules remain manually managed in Cursor Settings; this setup does not write a global User Rules file.
Project rules, project MCP, project agents, project ignore files, and AGENTS.md are never written by the global setup flow.
A one-time cleanup removes the legacy Riggverk-owned playwright:* mcpAllowlist entry during apply when present.
Never store credentials or private configuration in workspace templates.
